distributor.name: Eskom Holdings SOC Ltd (direct-supply and municipal bulk)
distributor.notes: Many municipalities (and large parts of others) are supplied directly by Eskom rather than a municipal distributor — Eskom's own NERSA-approved tariffs apply there. Eskom also sells bulk to municipal distributors (Municrate SPU, Municflex LPU, Public Lighting).

approved_increase.notes: Eskom municipal bulk purchase prices +9.01% effective 1 July 2026 (NERSA determination, 10 March 2026). Eskom DIRECT customers: +8.76% from 1 April 2026 (NERSA approved March 2026; 8.83% approved for the following year). Generation Capacity Charge fixed portion raised from 20% (FY2026) to 30% (FY2027). NERSA national Free Basic Electricity rate for 2026/27: 238.60 c/kWh.
